entries.note: Cao 2011 (PMID 21957197, JLR, epub 2011-09-25) read in full via PMC3220285; quote verbatim in abstract. Transgenic hCETP/apoAI mouse ex-vivo CETP inhibition is the class's PD model; untested opening correct.

entries.rule: brief: retrodiction (engagement is a target claim)
entries.note: Suico 2014 (PMID 24961753, epub 2014-06-24) quote verbatim in abstract; healthy volunteers, oral evacetrapib. Cao 2011 (epub 2011-09-25) post-dates de Grooth 2002 JTT-705 37% CETP-activity fall: retro, retrodiction true correct.

Full text states the margin: ZDF-rat MAP unchanged at 142-fold exposure multiple, 'will not likely induce blood pressure increases in humans'. model_id is the mouse slug though the margin rests on rats; consider a combined slug.

Suico: 91% CETP inhibition at 600 mg, no 24-h ABPM change; target reached and drug moved the surrogate, so same holds even without decision 16. Margin published 2011, after the MAD was run (published 2014); see rule question.
Same Cao 2011 quote, verbatim. Mouse work preceded phase 1 (paper says compound already in phase II), so not a retrodiction despite 2011 publication.

Nicholls 2011 (PMID 22089718) conclusion verbatim; co-primary HDL-C and LDL-C % change, both met, in judgement. Cao 2011 after JTT-705 HDL-C rise (2002): retro. Evacetrapib oral, dyslipidaemia patients unselected; registry results 2018-03-22 later than print.
Stated prediction of no torcetrapib-like BP/aldosterone liability confirmed in Cao full text (rat MAP, H295R CYP11B1/B2).

entries.rule: brief: safety, this disease's patients decide; rule 6
entries.note: Nicholls 2011 'Although the study was underpowered, no adverse effects were observed.' verbatim; dyslipidaemia patients, earliest public 2011 (Nov), after Cao 2011 (Sept), no earlier evacetrapib patient result, so not retro. Abstract does not name BP.

Choi 2019 (PMID 31311144) quote verbatim in abstract and full text. Rocacetrapib (CKD-519) is a listed member, oral; 2014 opener proxy (FIH start) allowed. Model's dose target stated, compared in entry 4.

entries.rule: brief: retrodiction (dose: same drug's own earlier result); failed retrodiction is contra
entries.note: Choi 2019 full-text quote verbatim. Kim 2016 (PMID 27895466, 2016-11-15) rocacetrapib SAD PK public before Choi 2019-07: retrodiction true; failed, so contra. Judgement keeps stale 'Not marked retrodiction' sentence; prose only.

entries.note: model_src Brown 1989 resolves; genetic HDL prediction public 1989, before any CETP-inhibitor patient result (JTT-705 2002), so prospective same holds for evacetrapib 2011; Nicholls quote verbatim. Outcome_tested negative (ACCELERATE) correct.

missing: Lilly press release 2015-10-12 announcing discontinuation of evacetrapib after ACCELERATE futility (tier 5, investor.lilly.com; page returned 403, not opened) dates the outcome failure to 2015, earlier than the NEJM 2017 / registry 2018 dates in patient_trials.

Rocacetrapib (CKD-519): Choi 2019 (https://doi.org/10.3390/pharmaceutics11070336, abstract) animal allometric PK/PD model predicted a 25 mg efficacious dose with a 'huge difference' from observed phase 1 bioavailability; published after phase 1 (Kim 2016, https://doi.org/10.2147/DDDT.S120387), so likely retrodiction/contra on a different model of a member drug. Drafter noted it in judgement but scored nothing; best-model rule keeps cell same.
Teramoto 2014 (PMID 24786356, Europe PMC abstract) gives patient CETP-activity engagement data in April 2014, ahead of Suico (June 2014).
DRL-17822 patient_trials quote is a paraphrase of the NCT01388816 results table, not a verbatim sentence; numbers (3.2/84.2/122.1/160.6%) verified.

Prospective pairing for the human-genetics track: Brown 1989 (https://doi.org/10.1038/342448a0) / Inazu 1990 (https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJM199011013231803) CETP deficiency raises HDL-C, confirmed in patients by de Grooth 2002 JTT-705/dalcetrapib phase 2 (https://doi.org/10.1161/01.CIR.0000015857.31889.7B): first class-level same, 2002.
rule_questions: Decision 16 margin_stated: does a margin count as 'stated before the trial' when the model data were generated pre-IND but first published (Cao 2011) after the human MAD that tested it was run, and before that MAD was published (2014)?
The same rat BP / exposure-multiple datum scores both dose (margin_stated same) and safety (same). 'Count the harm once' covers a harm that occurred; is double scoring allowed when no harm occurred?

Best-model rule vs member-specific dose models: should a different model's dose miss for another member (rocacetrapib PK/PD allometry, Choi 2019) appear as its own entry, and is a model published after phase 1 data a retrodiction even if it set the FIH dose?

Genetics track (cetp-lof-human-genetics): opener carries drug 'class'/route not_applicable while its comparison carries evacetrapib/oral; a track is model_id x drug x route, so the brief does not say whether these are one track or two.
